label: Mecha Clash
description: Heavy machinery in violent motion: craft, weather and sparks at cinema shutter.
prefix: A colossal action frame from a mecha epic — hundreds of tons in violent motion, the ground losing the argument, scale sold by debris and tiny fleeing figures.
suffix: Impact Rendering: (mass and inertia physically believable:1.25), hydraulics straining, armor plates shedding paint at the impact points, shockwave dust rings, motion blur only where physics demands it. Shot on a 40mm anamorphic at T2.2 with a 180-degree cinema shutter, oval bokeh and horizontal flares.
negative: watermark, text, toy-like scale, plastic sheen, static pose
